label: preparing
what: A secret jubilee/celebration for tomorrow at 18:00, with 200 fresh loaves on the great hall tables, eight installed lanterns, and the mayor discreetly invited under the pretext of a routine inspection. The baker knowingly supplied 56 loaves in exchange for 64 oak planks and agreed to keep the surprise private, so the baker also knowingly helped, although the core committee planning and organizing was by the innkeeper, freight operator, and builder.
